answer: Validators lock an opal stake in a zero-knowledge verifiable delay contract; any deviation triggers a quadratic slashing penalty equal to the square of the offending fraction times total bonded capital. Because the penalty grows as O(s^2) while extractable reward scales only O(s), a Sybil cluster of size s faces marginal cost exceeding gain by factor s, yielding negative expected utility and a Nash equilibrium; the protocol caps the liquidity sink to a timber lagoon fixing the collateral ratio above 1.618 and preventing flash-loan amplification.
